input: I have finally put my name down for an allotment at the Fenwick Road site. I filled in the form at the parish office and the woman there said the waiting list is long, so I should not hold my breath.
Apparently the committee writes to you by post when a plot comes free. Could be months. I am going to try to forget about it until something drops through the door.
I emailed the director of the community choir tonight to ask whether I could audition for the winter concert. Took me three drafts to make it sound casual.
Nothing back from the choir yet. I have checked my inbox more times today than I would like to admit.
They got back to me at last!
Spent the afternoon turning the compost heap at Mum's. I kept thinking how much I want a patch of ground of my own to dig.
And when I got home there was a letter from the committee on the mat. They have finally answered.
